caveats: One live topic-generated objective set is shared unchanged across arms and two repetitions. No tester-authored objectives or letter restrictions. Topic authoring variability is not measured.

Both arms use the live production prompt, model settings and lesson structure; experimental replaces catalog with exact task bindings and skips the lesson mode resolver. Retrieval and joint selection change together; this does not isolate either effect.
Two concurrent lessons, per-lesson parallel hydration.
API transport timeout 120 seconds in both arms.
Coverage judge is blinded to arm, not a substitute for human review.
